title: [silent-socket-loses-mark] A mark held during a silent outage is still lost without a word if the page is reloaded before the desk reconnects
where: Player desk, trauma record marks (frontend/src/store/gameStore.js heldMarks is not in partialize, so the unanswered take_mark with its mark_id dies with the page)
steps: Laptop 1366x768. 1. Player desk. 2. Make the socket silent both ways (no close) and let reconnects fail (blocked) for about 45 s. 3. At 6 s take a Body mark and let the 5 s Undo run out: the box is drawn held. 4. The banner says 'The connection to the table dropped. Reconnecting...'. At 45 s the network is back and the player reloads the page (instead of waiting for the reconnect). 5. Read the sheet, the database and the log.
expected: The held mark is sent again after the reload (it carries a mark_id the server de-duplicates), or the desk says plainly that the mark was not recorded.
actual: After the reload the Body track is empty (0 of 3), characters.body_marks is 0, no take_mark frame went out on the new socket, no log line, no message. Without the reload (waiting for the reconnect) the fix works: the mark is resent once and taken once (body 1, one log line), also when the server got the first frame but its answer was lost.

title: [dead-investigator-still-acts] Server still takes a fifth scar from a dead investigator's socket, and REST relationship propose accepts a dead proposer
steps: 1. Bram dies (4th scar). 2. On Bram's own socket send apply_scar {scar_text:'A fifth scar (-1 Move, +1 Strike)', shift_down:'move', shift_up:'strike'}. 3. POST /circle/relationship/propose with from_character_id = dead Bram (his token).
expected: Both refused with 409 'Bram Okafor is dead: the sheet is a record.' (FAQ.md:141: the server refuses the dead investigator's ... and the rest of the sheet's actions)
actual: apply_scar is accepted: scars_count 5, a fifth scar stored, Move lowered 1->0 and Strike raised on the dead record, character_update and member_status sent. REST propose returns ok and stores a 'proposed' relationship from the dead investigator. (The desk's own UI does not offer either; every other refused action - roll, spend, take_mark, drive, gear, use_ability, advancement, WS propose, revive - is refused as promised.)

title: [spend-back-unguarded-past-maximum] A real double-click on Give a spend back still gives two spends back
where: Lightkeeper desk 1440x900, member sheet, Circle spends this assignment (GMCharacterSheet.jsx SpendBack give())
steps: 1. Open spending; Ada spends Refresh and Stitch (2 / 2 used). 2. Lightkeeper opens Ada's sheet, picks Refresh under Put back in the pool. 3. Double-click Give a spend back as a person does (two clicks 60 to 400 ms apart).
expected: One spend back (1 of 2 used), one log line, as the fix promises ('a double-click is one press').
actual: Ada goes 2 -> 0 spends used, two log lines ('...(1 of 2 used this assignment), and a Refresh to the circle.' then '...(0 of 2 used this assignment).'). Measured at gaps of 60, 120, 180, 250 and 400 ms: always two. Only a zero-delay synthetic dblclick gives one. The guard in SpendBack only blocks a press while the member's count is unchanged, and the server's answer moves the count in a few ms, so the second click of any real double-click passes. The cap part of the fix holds (a full pool takes nothing back, option shows '(full)' disabled). The Lightkeeper has no way to take the extra spend away again.

title: [burn-offer-closes-on-anyones-roll] Burn and reroll is still 25 Tab presses after a keyboard roll, and focus on it falls to the page when the next roll closes it
where: Player desk, After the roll panel in the dice vault (DiceVault.jsx / RollModifications.jsx); laptop 1366x768, keyboard only
steps: Laptop 1366x768, keyboard only. 1. Focus Roll Strike (rating 0) and press Enter until the roll is a failure or mixed success. 2. Press Tab and count presses until Burn and reroll. 3. With focus on Burn and reroll, have another player roll.
expected: Burn reachable next (or soon) in the tab order after a roll, or focus moved to it after a non-success; when the next roll closes it, focus goes somewhere sensible (the 'Roll settled' i, or the roll's slip).
actual: Focus stays on Roll Strike; Burn and reroll is the 25th Tab stop (after the rest of the actions, the drive pips, the marks and Sounds). When another player's roll closes the panel, document.activeElement becomes BODY. The 'Roll settled' i note and the dice-button dot do now match the server (the other parts of this item are fixed).

title: [bonus-dice-vanish-silently] At 1366x768 the new 'what a reroll throws' i slip covers Burn and reroll, so moving from the i to the button presses the slip, not Burn
where: Player desk, After the roll panel (RollModifications.jsx InfoTerm on the pool line, added in PR 15); laptop 1366x768
steps: Laptop 1366x768. 1. Roll Read (rating 1) to a failure or mixed success. 2. In After the roll, hover the 'Read: 1 die (i)' line to read why. 3. Move the mouse straight down to Burn and reroll (28px below) and press.
expected: Burn and reroll stays reachable while or right after the note is read (the slip opens away from the button, or closes when the pointer leaves the i).
actual: The slip opens over Burn and reroll (button box x1056 y474 156x36 sits under it) and stays open while the pointer is over the slip; at the button's centre elementFromPoint is the slip's 'READ: 1 DIE:' span, and the press does nothing (no burn sent). The player has to move away and come back. At 1920x1080 the slip opens below the button and does not cover it.

steps: Desktop 1920x1080 / laptop 1366x768. Ada with Open Book and Interrogation, Cunning 6 (resistance 2). 1. Press the Open Book chip under Sway, roll Sway. 2. Read the chip, the slip and the log line.

title: [dice-tray-empty-after-reload] A reload right after an open (unsettled) roll still empties the tray and drops Burn and reroll, while the server still takes the burn
where: Player desk dice tray / After the roll (lastRoll is not persisted or resent on connect; send_held_roll resends only a held gilded roll or roll_settled); laptop 1366x768
steps: Laptop 1366x768. 1. Roll Survey to a mixed success or failure; the tray shows the dice and After the roll offers Burn and reroll. 2. Nobody else rolls. 3. Reload the page. 4. Look at the tray; then send burn_resistance for Survey from the same character.
expected: The tray shows the last roll again (or tray and log agree), and while the server still holds the roll open, the desk still offers Burn and reroll. Only a reload after a settled roll is accepted as an empty tray (decisions.md).
actual: After the reload the tray says 'No dice thrown yet', no Burn and reroll, no roll frame on the new socket; the log still lists the roll. A burn sent for that roll is accepted (roll_result, intuition_resistance_spent 0 -> 1), so the desk hides an option the table still allows. Same for a success (tray empty).
